crime_description: Forging the lost final manuscript of Ernest Hemingway. Interrogators should probe for connections to an inside literature expert, financial motives, remote burner phone coordination, offshore accounts, and private flight plans.

suspect.name: Lazarus Kane
suspect.fake_alibi: Lazarus claims he was holed up in a remote cabin writing his own novel.

secrets.value: Professor Alden, a literature expert who supplied authentic 1930s typewriter paper and ink.
Lazarus sought to finally achieve literary fame and fortune, even if fraudulently.
was actively coordinating the crime from a secure burner phone
untraceable offshore account holding the illicit funds
chartered a private flight under a fake identity
